name: input-file
description: File upload field with two layouts: DropZone (dashed drag-and-drop panel with a decorative files illustration) and Simple (a labeled Input field with a plus icon + placeholder, helper text, and a 'Take picture' action button). TODO: no obvious Radix primitive — likely wraps a native <input type="file"> plus drag-and-drop handlers; radixPrimitive left null pending adapter decision.

anatomy.notes: Outer container. DropZone renders a dashed-border drop panel; Simple renders a vertical stack (Input + helper text + action button).

Opaque decorative asset (Figma frame 'Decorative', node 113648:1343). Already hand-implemented at src/components/input-file/InputFileIllustration.tsx — treat as an opaque child component, do not rebuild from paths. Only 2 of its 24 vector paths (nodes 113648:1357 and 113648:1367) are variable-bound (bg/brand accent); the remaining 22 neutral paths use literal grays/whites and must NOT be tokenized. Only present in the DropZone variant.

'Choose your files' text next to the illustration. Only present in the DropZone variant. Its fontSize/fontStyle/fontFamily bindings resolve to variable IDs from a linked/shared library (hashed prefix, not a local file variable) — best-guess mapped by resolved value (18px / Regular / Test Calibre) to the same Sizing/Text/Large + Weight/Label + Family/Label tokens used elsewhere in this file.

Hidden (opacity 0) progress-bar artifact (Figma 'Frame 195', node 113648:1339) present inside the DropZone component but never rendered (opacity 0). Included for completeness only — do not implement visually. Its filled bar segment (Rectangle 28) is bound to bg/brand.

Only present in the Simple variant. Renders the DS <Input> component (Size=Small, Header=true, Label='Power of attorney', First Icon=true → plus icon, Description=true → 'PDF, JPG, PNG (20mo max)', Action Button=false). See .klp/figma-refs/input/spec.json for the Input component's own full token map.

Only present in the Simple variant. Renders the DS <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm"> with label 'Take picture' and a trailing camera icon (rightIcon). See .klp/figma-refs/button/spec.json for the Button component's own full token map.

a11y.notes: Both variants should ultimately drive a native <input type="file"> (visually hidden, triggered by click on the field/panel). DropZone should support native drag-and-drop (dragenter/dragover/drop) in addition to click-to-browse. The Simple variant's 'Take picture' button should set the capture attribute on its own hidden file input to invoke the device camera on mobile.
